FORM 10-K — ACME CORPORATION (CIK 0001234567), Fiscal Year Ended December 31, 2025.
(Synthetic fixture modeled on SEC 10-K structure; all companies fictitious.)

ITEM 1. BUSINESS.

Acme Corporation sells outdoor equipment through retail stores and online
channels. Order fulfilment runs on a central order management system that
creates an order record before any shipment leaves the warehouse. Trade
receivables are tracked in the accounting ledger (accounts receivable); invoices settle
within thirty days. The procurement office oversees supplier onboarding.

ITEM 1A. RISK FACTORS.

Supply chain disruption could delay fulfilment during peak season, causing
backorders across retail and online channels.

A cybersecurity incident affecting the order management system could expose
customer records and halt invoicing for several days.

Changes in sales-tax rules across jurisdictions may raise compliance costs
for the accounts receivable function.

ITEM 7. MANAGEMENT'S DISCUSSION AND ANALYSIS.

Revenue grew on higher order volume. Management strengthened inventory
controls and added a second reviewer for refunds above $10,000.
